texts.title: EVENT
texts.explain2:
We didn't plan the photo; it just happened, the way the best ones always do — somewhere between one sentence and the next, before anyone thought to pose, to fix a collar, or smooth a stray hair into place.

By the time we noticed the shutter had already fallen, the moment had slipped past us. And yet here it stays, kept exactly as it was: unrehearsed, a little imperfect, entirely ours — more honest than anything we could ever have arranged on purpose.
